title: Quarterly Remittance Return of Final Taxes Withheld on Interest Paid on Deposits and Yield on Deposit Substitutes/Trusts/Etc.

choice_rows.label: Item 13 — Payees availing of tax relief under a Special Law or Tax Treaty?
If over-remittance, mark one:
options: To be issued a Tax Credit Certificate
To be carried over to the next quarter

validation.how: Red label only for non-numeric input (field() compares input keys to model keys); model messages go to the bottom 'Needs review' box, capped at 20; Queue is disabled at the top with no reason shown.

findings.now: Once Item 13 is set to Yes, 'Special Rate' is already highlighted, so the return can be queued without you choosing a relief type.
findings.why: The official form leaves Item 13A blank and blocks queueing with 'Please select an option in item 13A.' (BIR-Form1602Qv2018.hta:5502), but the page fills the value before that check can run.

options.name: Blank until chosen
options.detail: Leave Item 13A unselected after Item 13 is Yes so the existing validation message still applies.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Use a select with an empty first entry, matching the official lstSpecialTax list (BIR-Form1602Qv2018.hta:635).

options.name: Buttons with no default
options.detail: Keep the three buttons but highlight none until the user clicks one.

findings.now: The quarter comes from the dashboard tile, yet Q1–Q4 stay clickable, and picking another quarter saves the return as a separate draft while the tile's draft stays behind.
findings.why: A draft is stored under its own quarter and year (crates/bir-core/src/db/queueable.rs:141), so the page's choice decides which row is written.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the period as a chip and change it only from the dashboard tile.

options.name: Combobox with warning
options.detail: Keep a picker, but warn before saving that another period opens a separate draft.

options.name: Lock after first save
options.detail: Allow changing the period only until a draft for that period has been saved.

findings.now: Most model errors do not turn their labels red; the messages appear only in the bottom 'Needs review' box, and 'Queue for submission' is disabled at the top with no reason shown.
findings.why: field() matches input keys such as 'year' against model keys such as 'taxable_year' (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1602q.rs:696), so only non-numeric entries turn a label red.

options.name: Pass the model error key
options.detail: Give field() an error key, as the 1604-C page already does with has_error(key, error_key).

options.name: Message beside the field
options.detail: Show each message under its own field, not only in the bottom panel.

options.name: Reason beside Queue
options.detail: Show the first blocking message next to the disabled Queue button.

findings.now: ATC is typed as free text (placeholder 'e.g. WC161'), and an unknown code is reported only after you try to queue.
findings.why: Only 13 ATC codes are accepted (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1602q.rs:126), and the official checks each code on blur (BIR-Form1602Qv2018.hta:1964).

options.name: Combobox per row
options.detail: Offer the 13 accepted ATCs in a combobox for each Schedule 2 row.

options.name: Read-only chips
options.detail: List the accepted codes as chips beside Schedule 2 so the user copies a valid one.

options.name: Check on blur
options.detail: Keep the text box but flag an unknown code when the field is left, as the official does.

findings.field: 20 — Tax remitted in return previously filed (amended only)
findings.now: After Item 3 changes from Yes to No, the disabled Item 20 box still shows the old amount, but Items 22 and 23 leave that amount out.
findings.why: The Item 3 buttons call edit() without reloading the editors (form_1602q_view.rs:585), while recompute() zeroes the amount (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_1602q.rs:429).

options.name: Reload on toggle
options.detail: Reload the editors after Item 3 changes, as set_withheld() already does for Item 4.

options.name: Clear the box
options.detail: Blank the Item 20 text when Item 3 is No.

options.name: Hide when not amended
options.detail: Show Item 20 only when Item 3 is Yes.

findings.now: The Needs review box shows at most 20 messages, so a return with more problems shows only the first 20.
findings.why: The list is cut with take(20) before it is rendered.

options.name: Show all messages
options.detail: Render every message in a scrollable list.

options.name: Count line
options.detail: Add 'N more problems' under the list when it is cut.

findings.now: The print preview shows the email in capital letters, although the stored email keeps the case typed.
findings.why: The print fill upper-cases writer-cell text joins and txtEmail is one (html-frozen/1602q-2019/writer-cells.json, p1c49), while the official capital() skips txtEmail (validation/package/js/string-util.js:241).

options.name: Skip the email in the upper-case step
options.detail: Exempt txtEmail in frozen_html.rs so print matches the stored value.

options.name: Named input on the sheet
options.detail: Give the frozen sheet a named txtEmail input so the join is not upper-cased.

options.name: Document the caps
options.detail: Keep the caps on paper and say on the preview that the email prints in capitals.
